definitions: To sit on (eggs) in order to hatch them by warmth.
To keep (eggs, embryos, or microorganisms) under conditions favorable for their development.
To develop slowly without outward manifestation.
To maintain (a culture of microorganisms) at a suitable temperature for growth.
To cause or allow to develop slowly and without outward manifestation.
examples: The hen will incubate her eggs for three weeks.
Scientists incubate the bacteria in a controlled environment.
The idea began to incubate in his mind.
We need to incubate the cells at 37 degrees Celsius.
She incubated a plan for several months.
